Frederick contended that certification determines if the case generates common answers.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests whether a judge can resolve materiality at the class certification stage. This step happens before a full trial on the merits.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: Amgen wants the Court to bar judges from deciding materiality at certification.
Plaintiffs want the Court to allow judges to decide materiality at certification.
